source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of thermoregulation in humans (PDF 8-9).

blocks.text: Insaan endothermic homeotherms hain, yaani apni hararat khud banate hain aur darja-e-hararat ek jaisa rakhte hain. Yeh negative feedback mechanism se jism ka darja-e-hararat qaboo karte hain. Maslan jild mein maujood thermoreceptors jism ke darja-e-hararat ka barhna ya girna pakarte hain. Yeh control centre yaani hypothalamus ko signal bhejte hain; hypothalamus mein bhi thermoreceptors hote hain.
